Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:
If a Banished vampire with cards, blood doll, equipment, gets brought back
into play as a zombie via spell of life, what happens to the attached cards?

Raille

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Raille wrote:
> If a Banished vampire with cards, blood doll, equipment, gets brought back
> into play as a zombie via spell of life, what happens to the attached cards?

Mummies, not zombies.

They keep the cards they have. Any blood counters roll off to the bank, however,
since allies can't have blood.
